title: Massabarkem (Gravesend Neck)
summary: Massabarkem is a Gravesend Neck placename in Kings County, connected with a 1650 confirmatory deed and related forms later discussed as Maseebackhun or Massebackhun.
map_geometry_source: Approximate modern Gravesend Neck / Gravesend, Brooklyn reference point; not an exact historical boundary.
history_content: The placename belongs to the Gravesend Neck landscape in present-day Brooklyn. Related scholarship connects Maseebackhun or Massebackhun with a land transaction involving Tomasurtum, Arree, Mackbans, Chippahicke, and Sywosson.
translation_content:
Related forms include Massabarkem, Maseebackhun, Massebackhun, and the OCR-like Massabarkern. The etymology remains uncertain and should not be presented as a confirmed translation.

Why Place Names Matter

“Place names are tied to the past, but they are maintained through daily usage.”

— Oregon Department of Education, Place and Remembrance: We Continue To Use Our Own Names (2024), Lesson text, PDF page 5
whereintheworld_content: Map location note: The pin uses a modern Gravesend Neck / Gravesend, Brooklyn location for map visibility and is not an exact boundary for the 1650 tract.
